title: 第六章 炼药师
content_zh:
床榻之上，少年闭目盘腿而坐，双手在身前摆出奇异的手印，胸膛轻微起伏，一呼一吸间，形成完美的循环，而在气息循环间，有着淡淡的白色气流顺着口鼻，钻入了体内，温养着骨骼与武动乾坤。
在少年闭目修炼之时，手指上那古朴的黑色戒指，再次诡异的微微发光，旋即沉寂
“呼”缓缓的吐出一口浊气，少年双眼乍然睁开，一抹淡淡的白芒在漆黑的眼中闪过，那是刚刚被吸收，而又未被完全炼化的斗之气武动乾坤。
“好不容易修炼而来的斗之气，又在消失我，我草”沉神感应了一下体内，少年脸庞猛然的愤怒了起来，声音有些尖锐的骂道武动乾坤。
拳头死死的捏在了一起，半晌后，少年苦笑着摇了摇头，身心疲惫的爬下了床，舒展了一下有些发麻的脚腕与大腿，仅仅拥有三段斗之气的他，可没有能力无视各种疲累武动乾坤。
简单的在房间中活动了下身体，房间外传来苍老的声音：“三少爷，族长请你去大厅”
三少爷，萧炎在家中排行老三，上面还有两位哥哥，不过他们早已经外出历练，只有年终，才会偶尔回家，总的说来，两位哥哥对萧炎这位亲弟弟，也很是不错武动乾坤。
“哦。”随口的应了下来，换了一身衣衫，萧炎走出房间，对着房外的一名青衫老者微笑道：“走吧，墨管家。”
望着少年稚嫩的脸庞，青衫老者和善的点了点头，转身的霎那，浑浊的老眼，掠过一抹不易察觉的惋惜，唉，以三少爷以前的天赋，恐怕早该成为一名出色的斗者了吧，可惜
跟着老管家从后院穿过，最后在肃穆的迎客大厅外停了下来，恭敬的敲了门，方才轻轻的推门而入武动乾坤。
大厅很是宽敞，其中的人数也是不少，坐于最上方的几位，便是萧战与三位脸色淡漠的老者，他们是族中的长老，权利不比族长小武动乾坤。
在四人的左手下方，坐着家族中一些有话语权且实力不弱的长辈，在他们的身旁，也有一些在家族中表现杰出的年轻一辈武动乾坤。
另外一边，坐着三位陌生人，想必他们便是昨夜萧战口中所说的贵客武动乾坤。
有些疑惑的目光在陌生的三人身上扫过，三人之中，有一位身穿月白衣袍的老者，老者满脸笑容，神采奕奕，一双有些细小的双眼，却是精光偶闪，萧炎的视线微微下移，最后停在了老者胸口上，心头猛然一凛，在老者的衣袍胸口处，赫然绘有一弯银色浅月，在浅月周围，还有点缀着七颗金光闪闪的星辰武动乾坤。
“七星大斗师这老人竟然是一位七星大斗师真是人不可貌相”萧炎心中大感惊异，这老者的实力，竟然比自己的父亲，还要高出两星武动乾坤。
能够成为大斗师的人，至少都是名动一方的强者，那样的实力，将会让得任何势力趋之若鹜，而忽然间看见一位如此等级的强者，也难怪萧炎会感到诧异武动乾坤。
老者身旁，坐有一对年轻的男女，他们的身上同样穿着相同的月白袍服，男子年龄在二十左右，英俊的相貌，配上挺拔的身材，很是具有魅力，当然，最重要的，还是其胸口处所绘的五颗金星，这代表着青年的实力：五星斗者
能够以二十岁左右的年龄成为一名五星斗者，这说明青年的修炼天赋，也很是不一般武动乾坤。
英俊的相貌，加上不俗的实力，这位青年，不仅将家族中的一些无知少女迷得神魂颠倒，就是连那坐在一旁的萧媚，美眸中在移向这边之时，也是微放着异彩武动乾坤。
少女虽然暗送秋波，不过这似乎对青年并没有什么吸引力，此时，这位青年正将所有的注意力，集中在自己身旁的美丽少女身上

这位少女年龄和萧炎相仿，让萧炎有些意外的，她的容貌，竟然比萧媚还要美上几分，在这家族之中，恐怕也只有那犹如青莲一般的萧熏儿能够与之相比，难怪这男子对族中的这些胭脂俗粉不屑一顾武动乾坤。
少女娇嫩的耳垂上吊有着绿色的玉坠，微微摇动间，发出清脆的玉响，突兀的现出一抹娇贵
另外，在少女那已经开始发育的玲珑小胸脯旁，绘有三颗金星武动乾坤。
“三星斗者，这女孩如果没有靠外物激发的话，那便是一个绝顶天才”心头轻轻的吸了一口凉气，萧炎的目光却只是在少女冷艳的小脸上停留了瞬间便是移了开去，不管如何说，在他幼稚的外貌下，也是拥有一个成熟的灵魂，虽然少女很美丽，不过他也没闲心露出流口水的猪哥状来讨人嫌武动乾坤。
萧炎的这举动似乎有些让得少女略感诧异，虽然她并不是那种以为世界围着自己转的女孩，不过自己的美貌与气质如何，她再清楚不过，萧炎的这番随意动作，倒真让她有点意外，当然，也仅此而已
“父亲，三位长老”快步上前，对着上位的萧战四人恭敬的行了一礼武动乾坤。
“呵呵，炎儿，来了啊，快坐下吧。”望着萧炎的到来，萧战止住了与客人的笑谈，冲着他点了点头，挥手道武动乾坤。
微笑点头，萧炎只当做没有看见一旁三位长老射来的不耐以及淡淡的不屑，回头在厅中扫了扫，却是愕然发现，竟然没自己的位置
“唉，自己在这家族中的地位，看来还真是越来越低啊，往日倒好，现在竟然是当着客人的面给我难堪，这三个老不死的啊”心头自嘲的一笑，萧炎暗自摇头武动乾坤。
望着站在原地不动的萧炎，周围的族中年轻人，都是忍不住的发出讥笑之声，显然很是喜欢看他出丑的模样武动乾坤。
此时，上面的萧战也是发现了萧炎的尴尬，脸庞上闪过一抹怒气，对着身旁的老者皱眉道：“二长老，你”
“咳，实在抱歉，竟然把三少爷搞忘记了，呵呵，我马上叫人准备”被萧战瞪住的黄袍老者，淡淡的笑了笑，“自责”的拍了拍额头，只是其眼中的那抹讥讽，却并未有多少遮掩武动乾坤。
“萧炎哥哥，坐这里吧”少女淡淡的笑声，忽然的在大厅中响了起来武动乾坤。
三位长老微愣，目光移向角落中安静的萧熏儿，嘴巴蠕了蠕，竟然是都没有敢再说话
在大厅的角落处，萧熏儿微笑着合拢了手中厚厚的书籍，气质淡雅从容，对着萧炎可爱的眨了眨眼睛武动乾坤。
望着萧熏儿那微笑的小脸，萧炎迟疑了一下，摸着鼻子点了点头，然后在众多少年那嫉妒的目光中，走了过去，挨着她坐了下去武动乾坤。
“你又帮我解围了。”嗅着身旁少女的淡淡体香，萧炎低笑道武动乾坤。
萧熏儿浅浅一笑，小脸上露出可爱的衅窝，纤细的指尖再次翻开手中那本古朴的书籍，小小年纪，却有一种知性的美感，眨动着修长的睫毛在书中徘徊了片刻，忽然有些幽幽的道：“萧炎哥哥有三年没和熏儿单独坐一起了吧”
“呃现在熏儿可是家族中的天才了，想要朋友还不简单么”瞧得少女有些幽怨的光洁侧脸，萧炎干笑道武动乾坤。
“在熏儿四岁到六岁的时候，每天晚上都有人溜进我的房间，然后用一种很是笨拙的手法以及并不雄厚的斗之气，温养我的骨骼与经脉，每次都要弄得自己大汗淋漓后，方才疲惫离开，萧炎哥哥，你说，他会是谁”熏儿沉默了半晌，忽然的偏过头，对着萧炎嫣然一笑，少女独有的风情，让得周围的少年眼睛有些放光武动乾坤。

“咳我，我怎么知道那么小，我们都还在地上爬呢，我哪知道。”心头猛的一跳，萧炎讪笑了两声，旋即有些心虚的将目光转向大厅内武动乾坤。
“嘻嘻”望着萧炎的反映，萧熏儿小嘴泛起了柔和的笑意，目光转移到书籍之上，口中似乎是自喃般的淡淡道：“虽然知道他是好意，可熏儿不管怎么说也是女孩子吧哪有偷偷摸女孩子身体的道理，若是熏儿寻出了那人，哼”
嘴角裂了裂，萧炎心头有些心虚，眼观鼻，鼻观心，不言不语
content_en:
On the bed, the young man sat cross-legged with his eyes closed. His hands were placed in strange mudras in front of him. His chest rose and fell slightly, forming a perfect cycle with each breath. During the cycle of breath, there was a faint white air flowing along the mouth and nose, and penetrated into the body, warming the bones and martial arts.
When the young man closed his eyes and practiced, the simple black ring on his finger once again shone strangely, then fell silent.
"Huh" slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, the young man's eyes suddenly opened, a faint white light flashed in the dark eyes, that was the fighting spirit that had just been absorbed but had not been completely refined.
"The fighting spirit that I finally cultivated is disappearing again. I am a fool." Shen Shen sensed something in his body, and the young man's face suddenly became angry, and he cursed Wu Da Qian Kun in a sharp voice.
The young man clenched his fists tightly together. After a while, the young man shook his head with a wry smile. He climbed out of bed exhausted both physically and mentally, and stretched his numb ankles and thighs. He only had three levels of Dou Qi, but he did not have the ability to ignore all kinds of fatigue and move the world.
He simply moved his body in the room, and an old voice came from outside the room: "Third Young Master, the patriarch invites you to go to the hall."
Third Young Master, Xiao Yan is the third eldest in the family, and there are two older brothers above him. However, they have already gone out to practice, and only come home occasionally at the end of the year. Generally speaking, the two older brothers treat Xiao Yan, his biological younger brother, very well in Wu Dong Qian Kun.
"Oh." He responded casually, changed his clothes, walked out of the room, smiled at an old man in green clothes outside the room and said, "Let's go, Butler Mo."
Looking at the young man's immature face, the old man in green clothes nodded kindly. The moment he turned around, a trace of imperceptible regret flashed across his cloudy old eyes. Alas, with the talent of the third young master, he should have become an outstanding fighter long ago. It's a pity.
Following the old butler through the backyard, he finally stopped outside the solemn reception hall, knocked on the door respectfully, and then gently opened the door and entered Wudong Qiankun.
The hall is very spacious, and there are many people in it. The people sitting at the top are Xiao Zhan and three old men with indifferent faces. They are the elders of the clan and have no more power than the clan leader Xiao Wu.
Under the left hands of the four people, there are some elders in the family who have the right to speak and are not weak in strength. Next to them, there are also some younger generations who have performed outstandingly in the family.
On the other side, there were three strangers sitting. They must be the distinguished guests that Xiao Zhan mentioned last night.
Some doubtful eyes swept over the three unfamiliar people. Among the three people, there was an old man wearing a moon-white robe. The old man was smiling and full of energy. His eyes were a little small, but they were shining occasionally. Xiao Yan's eyesight The line moved down slightly, and finally stopped on the old man's chest. My heart suddenly froze. On the chest of the old man's robe, there was a silver moon. Around the moon, there were seven shining golden stars.
"This old man is actually a Seven-Star Great Fighter. It's really beyond appearances." Xiao Yan was greatly surprised. The strength of this old man was actually two stars higher than his father's.
Anyone who can become a great fighting master must be at least a well-known and strong person. Such strength will make any force flock to him, and when he suddenly sees a strong person of this level, it is no wonder that Xiao Yan is surprised.
Next to the old man, there was a pair of young men and women sitting. They were also wearing the same moon-white robes. The man was about 20 years old. His handsome appearance and tall figure made him very attractive. Of course, the most important thing was the five gold stars painted on his chest, which represented the strength of the youth: Five-Star Fighter
Being able to become a five-star fighter at the age of about twenty years old shows that the young man's cultivation talent is also very extraordinary.With his handsome appearance and considerable strength, this young man not only fascinated some ignorant girls in the family, but even Xiao Mei, who was sitting next to him, had a slightly brilliant look in his beautiful eyes when he moved towards this side.
Although the girl was making secret glances, it didn't seem to attract the young man. At this time, the young man was focusing all his attention on the beautiful girl beside him.
This girl is similar in age to Xiao Yan, so Xiao Yan is a little surprised. Her appearance is actually a bit more beautiful than Xiao Mei. Among this family, only Xiao Xun'er, who is like a green lotus, can compare with her. No wonder this man disdains the rouge fans in the family and doesn't care about Wu Da Qian Kun.
There is a green jade pendant hanging from the girl's delicate earlobe. When she shakes it slightly, it makes a crisp jade sound, suddenly showing a touch of elegance.
In addition, next to the girl's exquisite little breasts that have begun to develop, there are three Venuses moving the universe.
"Three-Star Fighter, if this girl is not inspired by external objects, she is an extremely talented person." Xiao Yan took a breath of cold air in his heart, but his eyes only stayed on the girl's cold face for a moment and then moved away. In any case, under his childish appearance, he also has a mature soul. Although the girl is very beautiful, he does not have the time to show off his drooling pig-like appearance to impress others.
Xiao Yan's move seemed to surprise the girl. Although she was not the kind of girl who thought the world revolved around her, she knew her beauty and temperament very well. Xiao Yan's random move really surprised her, but of course, that's all.
"Father, the three elders" stepped forward quickly and bowed respectfully to the superior Xiao Zhan and the others.
"Haha, Yan'er, here we come, sit down quickly." Seeing Xiao Yan's arrival, Xiao Zhan stopped joking with the guests, nodded at him, waved and said, "We can move the world."
Smiling and nodding, Xiao Yan pretended not to see the impatience and slight disdain from the three elders beside him. He turned around and scanned the hall, but was shocked to find that there was no place for him.
"Oh, my status in this family seems to be getting lower and lower. It was good in the past, but now they are embarrassing me in front of the guests, these three old immortals." Xiao Yan smiled at himself, shaking his head secretly.
Looking at Xiao Yan who was standing still, the young people around him couldn't help but laugh at him, obviously they really enjoyed watching him make a fool of himself.
At this time, Xiao Zhan, who was above, also noticed Xiao Yan's embarrassment. A flash of anger flashed across his face, and he frowned at the old man beside him and said, "Second Elder, you..."
"Ahem, I'm really sorry. I forgot about the third young master. Haha, I'll call someone to prepare right away." The old man in yellow robe, who was glared at by Xiao Zhan, smiled faintly and patted his forehead "blaming himself". The sarcasm in his eyes did not cover Wu Dongqiankun much.
"Brother Xiao Yan, please sit here." The girl's faint laughter suddenly rang out in the hall.
The three elders were stunned for a moment, their eyes moved to Xiao Xun'er who was quiet in the corner, their mouths were squirming, but they didn't even dare to speak anymore.
In the corner of the hall, Xiao Xun'er closed the thick books in her hands with a smile, her temperament was elegant and calm, and she winked cutely at Xiao Yan.
Looking at Xiao Xun'er's smiling face, Xiao Yan hesitated for a moment, touched his nose and nodded, then walked over and sat down next to Wu Dong Qiankun under the jealous eyes of many teenagers.
"You helped me out again." Sniffing the faint body fragrance of the girl next to him, Xiao Yan chuckled and said Wu Dong Qian Kun.
Xiao Xun'er smiled lightly, her little face showing a cute dimple, and her slender fingertips once again opened the ancient book in her hand. At such a young age, she has an intellectual sense of beauty.Blinking her slender eyelashes, she lingered in the book for a moment, and suddenly said faintly: "Brother Xiao Yan hasn't sat alone with Xun'er for three years, right?"
"Well, now Xun'er is a genius in the family. Isn't it easy to have friends?" Looking at the girl's smooth side face with some resentment, Xiao Yan smiled dryly and said Wu Da Qian Kun.
"When Xun'er was four to six years old, someone would sneak into my room every night, and then use a very clumsy technique and weak fighting spirit to warm my bones and meridians, making me sweat profusely every time. Finally, he left tiredly, Brother Xiao Yan, tell me who he could be." Xun'er was silent for a long time, then suddenly turned his head and smiled sweetly at Xiao Yan. The girl's unique charm made the eyes of the surrounding teenagers shine.
"Ahem, how did I know that you were so young? We are still crawling on the ground. How did I know?" His heart skipped a beat, and Xiao Yan laughed twice, and then turned his gaze to Wu Dou Qian Kun in the hall with some guilt.
"Hehe" looking at Xiao Yan's reaction, a soft smile appeared on Xiao Xun'er's small mouth. She shifted her gaze to the book and said lightly as if she was mumbling to herself: "Although I know he means well, Xun'er is a girl anyway. There is no reason to secretly touch a girl's body. If Xun'er finds that person, huh"
The corners of his mouth were cracked, and Xiao Yan felt a little guilty. He looked at his nose with his eyes, his nose at his heart, and said nothing.
